annotations.title: Links to view several media files

description: Private links, valid an hour, to up to 50 ready media files at once, each with a link to its small JPEG poster when it has one (every video gets one shortly after upload) and, for a video, play_url to watch it. Freed media (the original cleared after posting) comes back with freed true and url pointing at its poster. Anyone holding a link can open it until it expires, so never paste one anywhere public.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
